fair_value_reason: Starts from the round-2 forecaster mean of $42.2 (43.0/43.5/39.5/42.0/43.0), which now shares the corrected inputs: ~262M shares, 12.5% Turkish CIT, 650 koz legacy + McIlvenna, ~$4,000-4,200 gold. Putting agents 1, 3 and 5 on a ~$5.75/lb copper deck (spot ~$6.5 less mean reversion) instead of $4.75-5.02 adds ~$2-3/sh each, or ~+$1.3 on the mean. Hedges are immaterial for 2027. That gives ~$43.5, about 14% above $38.12, at ~10x NTM EPS of ~$4.3 or ~5.75x 2027 EBITDA of ~$2.15B.
supervisor_summary: In round 2 the five forecasters converged (fair values $39.5-43.5, medians ~$38.6-41.3) after adopting the share-count, Turkish-tax and consensus-deck corrections. The remaining factual gap is copper: three agents price it at $4.75-5.02/lb against ~$6.5 spot, with no hedges after July 2026. Fixing that lifts reconciled fair value to ~$43.5, about 14% above $38.12. The round-1 supervisor wrongly doubted agent_1: the Q2 MD&A does put Skouries' filtered tailings on the critical path, which keeps Q4 commercial production a live risk. The stock remains a ~2.5x gold proxy, so I nudge the mean ladder up only ~1 point at the middle strikes, with low confidence. Q3 results on 28 Oct and the McIlvenna and Skouries commercial-production declarations are the next checkpoints.
key_drivers: Gold: spot $4,137 (3 Oct), against a $5,597 intraday peak in Jan 2026; EGO's 12-month beta to gold is ~2.6 and dominates outcomes.

Skouries: first concentrate 8 Sep (~2 months late), grid power 28 Sep, filtered tailings on the critical path at Q2, commercial production guided for Q4 2026; 2027 outlook of 150-180 koz Au and 50-70 Mlb Cu.
2027 volume step-up to 620-720 koz from legacy assets (McIlvenna Bay excluded) and ~95 Mlb of copper, with copper at ~$6.5/lb spot and no copper hedges after July 2026.
Turkey: CIT falls to 12.5% from 2027 (+~$50M/yr), partly offset by royalty bands extended to $5,101/oz.
Balance sheet: ~$1.2B net debt, with €740M term-facility amortisation from 31 Dec 2026 and Sprott from Jun 2027, so 2027 FCF (~$0.9-1.1B in agents' builds, $1.5B consensus) must arrive on time.
